strings.name: Eugene Kaspersky
strings.role: Cybersecurity researcher, Kaspersky cofounder and CEO
strings.summary: Eugene Kaspersky began by analyzing a virus on his own computer, then built antivirus tools and a company with colleagues. He moved from research leadership to CEO and expanded malware analysis and international business. The company investigated threats including Stuxnet but faced scrutiny over Russian ties. The US restricted its products in 2024; the company denies the alleged security threat.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Kaspersky and advanced malware research, influencing the global cybersecurity industry and threat analysis.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated in 1987 from Moscow's cryptography, telecommunications and computer science institute
strings.highlights.h1.title: Developing security research
strings.highlights.h1.text: With teams, he built antivirus products and threat research, contributing to analysis of complex cyberattacks.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Global business and trust disputes
strings.highlights.h2.text: He advanced Swiss data processing and transparency measures while facing security-based restrictions in markets including the US.
strings.timeline.t1.title: US product restrictions announced
strings.timeline.t1.text: US authorities found national-security risks and phased in sales and update restrictions; the company contested the determination.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Swiss data processing begins
strings.timeline.t2.text: Suspicious files voluntarily shared by European users began processing in Zurich data centers.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Cofounding No More Ransom
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company worked with Dutch police, Europol and Intel Security to help ransomware victims.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Stuxnet investigation
strings.timeline.t4.text: Its researchers analyzed industrial-control malware alongside other investigating organizations.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becoming CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: He moved from leading antivirus research to chief executive.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Cofounding the company
strings.timeline.t6.text: With colleagues, he established an independent security company and led antivirus research.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Beginning virus analysis
strings.timeline.t7.text: After a Cascade infection, he wrote a removal tool and accumulated detection programs.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Professional education
strings.timeline.t8.text: He trained in cryptography, computing and mathematical engineering before research work.
